posts.title: Polla 2026 archive
posts.description: Since hosting the Polla 2026 application costs money, I created a static archive which now lives at https://polla2026.kirsch.mx and decomissioned the original polla. I could have just taken it down, but I like keeping the historical tournament around. The original URL https://polla2026.com will redirect until I get tired or renewing it.
